annotations.title: Screen names against official sanctions lists

description: Screens people and organisations against the official sanctions lists read from each publisher: US OFAC SDN and consolidated (non-SDN), UN Security Council, EU consolidated financial sanctions, UK Sanctions List, Canada and Switzerland (SECO). Matching handles transliteration (Cyrillic, Arabic), word order, patronymics, initials and company forms. Returns a verdict per name (match, possible-match, no-match) with the matching entries: list, programmes, countries, birth dates, identifiers, listing date and link. A screening aid, not legal advice. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/sanctions-screener on your Apify account (about $0.003 per name; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

country.description: For a single subject: a nationality or country (name or ISO code).

date_of_birth.description: For a single person: a date or year of birth, which lowers matches with a different birth year.

entity_type.description: People only, organisations (with vessels and aircraft) only, or both.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

min_score.description: Name similarity from which an entry is reported.

names.description: People or organisations to screen, e.g. ["Rosneft", "Vladimir Putin"].

name: screen_sanctions

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
